title: Similarity & AI-text Detection
body: Checks similarity directly against the corpus of Thai articles in ThaiJO, complementing existing tools such as Akarawisut and Turnitin, and estimates the share of AI-generated text as input for the editor's assessment.

title: TH↔EN Abstract Translator & Academic Polishing
body: Translates abstracts between Thai and English with field-specific terminology, and polishes academic writing while keeping the original meaning and content intact.

title: Thai Citation Style Formatter
body: Automatically formats reference lists in Thai-language APA 7, Vancouver or each journal's own house style, building on Reference Extraction & Validation.

title: Metadata & Keyword Enrichment
body: Suggests keywords, subject areas and metadata that follow Crossref/DOI and OJS standards, so articles are easier to discover and index in ThaiJO, TCI, ACI and international databases.

title: Citation Recommender
body: Suggests further ThaiJO research worth citing, based on the manuscript text as you write. Results are ranked by relevance only, not by T-JIF, to prevent citing just to boost metrics.

title: Submission Pre-check
body: Checks a manuscript against the journal's author guidelines before submission, covering length, section structure, bilingual abstracts, keywords, AI-use disclosure and human research ethics documents, to reduce returns from the editorial office.
